description:
When Unicode/NFKD normalization is added in v0.2, the current fallback to raw DER byte comparison for TeletexString and BMPString (lines 575-579, 567) will create ambiguity: should these types be decoded and normalized like modern string types, or remain byte-exact comparisons?

Current code documents the v0.1 limitation but does not commit to a v0.2 strategy. Before implementing Unicode support, add a design note (rustdoc or RFC comment) clarifying:
1. Will TeletexString/BMPString be decoded and NFKD-normalized?
2. If yes, what decoding + normalization logic applies?
3. If no, what is the justification for differential treatment?

This prevents v0.2 maintainers from discovering ambiguity mid-implementation.
notes: Review converged after 2 rounds. Final review: PKIX-2oe.
title: Document v0.2 legacy string type normalization strategy
